title: evt.user.registered v1
description: A user registered. Published by krizaka-users through its outbox on the platform's events exchange; the body is the bare event, the envelope travels in the kz-* AMQP headers. A consumer reads the fields it needs and ignores the others.

preferences.description: Free-form user preferences; language (an ISO 639 code, default en) is always present.

plaintextToken.description: The e-mail verification token, when the account must be verified; null otherwise.
